name: tombi-wasm
description: Tombi formatter, linter, and language server for WebAssembly

scripts.build:lib: wasm-pack build --locked --target web --out-dir dist/lib --out-name tombi_wasm -- --no-default-features --features lib
scripts.build:lsp: wasm-pack build --locked --target web --out-dir dist/lsp --out-name tombi_lsp_wasm -- --no-default-features --features lsp
scripts.build:docs: rm -f ../../docs/public/wasm/tombi_wasm.d.ts ../../docs/public/wasm/tombi_wasm.js ../../docs/public/wasm/tombi_wasm_bg.wasm ../../docs/public/wasm/tombi_wasm_bg.wasm.d.ts && wasm-pack build --locked --target web --out-dir ../../docs/public/wasm --out-name tombi_lsp_wasm -- --no-default-features --features lsp && cp src/lsp-worker.js ../../docs/public/wasm/worker.js
scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && pnpm run build:lib && pnpm run build:lsp && pnpm run build:worker && pnpm run build:metadata && pnpm run build:copy
scripts.test: pnpm run test:lib && pnpm run test:lsp
